body.def: At constant \(X\), differentiate the normalized \(K\times K\times K\) feature tensor and invert the separated finite Jacobian on its observed score image to recover the centered scores of \(\pi\), \(M_A\), \(M_Z\), and \(\Gamma_Y\)
body.role: Finite-dimensional first step of the DQM lifting argument.
